finding.summary: The successful build-evidence job neither retained nor attested an SBOM even though its step names claimed both.
blocks: R4 adoption as a release-ready candidate
a claim that Constitutional CI produced SBOM evidence
V4 qualification until corrected CI is observed

atomic_claims.claim: A successful workflow conclusion proves that both named subject paths were attested.
atomic_claims.advocate_case: The attestation step accepted both the wheel glob and the SBOM path and returned success.
atomic_claims.cross_examination: The artifact contains no SBOM and independent attestation verification returns only the wheel subject.
atomic_claims.expert_evidence: GitHub artifact 9871406573 and gh attestation verification of its sole file

atomic_claims.claim: The pinned Anchore action accepts output-file and upload suppression inputs.
atomic_claims.advocate_case: Those names are accepted by newer releases of related SBOM actions.
atomic_claims.cross_examination: The exact pinned action manifest omits all three inputs and the runner emitted an explicit warning.
atomic_claims.expert_evidence: SRC-V4-007 at exact commit and run 33694910734 logs

atomic_claims.claim: The successor can fail closed by invoking the pinned Syft binary directly, validating the file, and naming both exact upload and attestation paths.
atomic_claims.advocate_case: The pinned download sub-action exports the command, pins Syft v0.42.2, and official Syft documentation supports spdx-json=file output.
atomic_claims.cross_examination: Repository inspection alone cannot prove the remote runner will create, upload, and attest both subjects.
atomic_claims.expert_evidence: SRC-V4-008 through SRC-V4-010 and a local CI-contract regression test

requirements: download Syft through the exact pinned sub-action
scan the repository package and write dist/hive-mind-os.spdx.json explicitly
require one wheel and a non-empty parseable SPDX document with core fields and at least one discovered package
upload exactly the wheel and SBOM with if-no-files-found set to error
present both exact paths to the provenance attestation action

rollback: Revert the successor workflow and regression-test changes; retain this adverse audit and the original green-but-incomplete run evidence.
forbidden_claims: the V4 correction is remotely proven before candidate CI
